title: Day 1 · a second Short Rest, in room 1.4
headline: Morten rests another hour and spends his last Hit Die. It rolls a 1, so he only gets back to 13/20 HP.

bullets.label: Hit Die
bullets.text: 1d6+2 = 3 HP. Morten 10 → 13/20 HP. No Hit Dice left until the Long Rest.

bullets.label: Where he stands
bullets.text: every spell ready, but no potion, no Heroic Inspiration and no Arcane Recovery. Mage Armor lasts until 17:10 and the lamp until 15:10.

bullets.label: Morten (GM)
bullets.text: "Four rooms down, two to go if the pattern holds. The owl looks first. Anything like that Blink Dog, and I go back upstairs."
